leads.name: Liftoff (Contract Communications Manager)
leads.notes: Combined 80, A (flagged). Named operating-company contract Communications Manager role at Liftoff, a mobile growth/adtech platform — clean B2B SaaS sector fit and a true in-house contract engagement rather than another talent network. CAUTION: surfaced via a RemotePRJobs social listing; exact posting date and whether it is still open could NOT be confirmed in this run (recency scored 0). Verify live status on liftoff.io/careers or RemotePRJobs before pitching. PITCH: senior comms operator who can own media relations + corporate/product comms on contract and ramp fast. Distinguish employmentTypeRaw (contract) from rate basis — confirm 1099 vs W2.

leads.employmentTypeRaw: Fractional Director of Communications (long-term contract, ~25 hrs/wk)
leads.notes: Combined 70, B. Best direct-apply lead this run. Three-year-old foundation building its comms function from a low public profile — wants a fractional comms leader to run a comms assessment, build the strategic plan, then own execution (media strategy, press relationships, brand, thought leadership). True fractional structure: 12-18 month contract, ~25 hrs/wk, remote, direct email careers@fourpines.org, rolling review. SECTOR fit is the weak point (philanthropy/healthcare, not finance/PE), scored 0 — but the engagement model, workstream and direct apply path are exactly Mark's lane. Sensitive subject matter (suicide care): pitch should show judgment handling stigmatized topics. PITCH: senior operator who can both set strategy and execute hands-on while a function is stood up.
